scene_selection: all six validation scenes, including missing-wall failures; no model-response selection

core_screening.scope: mechanistic screening, not repeatability or generalization estimate

optional_full_second_block.order: complement first block into three complete four-row Williams blocks; freeze all requests before execution

reliability_expression_extension.additional_payload: public-only reliability.json fields; no diagnostic GT plane errors, scores, witnesses or private designs
reliability_expression_extension.paired_reference: same scene B2_geometry; interleave and counterbalance B2/B2_R order before authorization
reliability_expression_extension.interpretation: effect of public reliability information/expression; never attribute this contrast to improved geometry
reliability_expression_extension.extra_instruction: explicitly state missing boxes do not imply free space; version separately

fixed.RGB_task_policy_schema: same per scene across main conditions; only geometry differs

before_new_authorization: freeze exact payloads, hashes, order and repeat count in independent proposal version
verify bridge non-generation health, authentication and timeout
independent fresh authorization only after user approval; no ledger created now
record: cached input tokens and all reported tokens separately
client latency includes network/queueing; not pure model time
geometry construction + input preparation + model call end-to-end latency
raw JSON/events, parameter checks, completion status, stop on protocol/transport error
score valid geometry failures as zero; protocol failures NOT_SCORED
caveats: six scenes already inspected with GT; future model comparison is diagnostic, not unseen reconstruction validation
A/B/C historical outputs are references, not repetitions
B2 missing geometry is known; reliability is not calibrated and box-only acceptance is not safety certification
